posts.text: The whole ride back from Adelanto, she spent talking about how she’s worried for the people she left behind. Her dreams of being free were to help her friends and how she wants to send them weekly letters to look forward to. As well as how thankful she was for everyone caring about her. But her fight isn’t over, so if you are able, please help them out. Thank you. #auntiejo #changyeonjo #newlyweds #help #love
